# Teens in Print

> A Boston-based nonprofit amplifying marginalized youth voices through student writing, publishing, and mentorship programs.

Teens in Print (TiP) empowers 8th-12th grade students from underrepresented communities to develop writing skills, share their stories, and build media literacy through structured programs like the Summer Journalism Institute and after-school workshops. The organization connects student writers with professional mentors and provides platforms for youth publishing and leadership development.

- [Get your students involved](https://teensinprint.com/get-your-students-involved): Student recruitment and program information for 8th-12th grade participants

- [About Us](https://teensinprint.com/about): Organization mission: amplifying marginalized voices of Boston youth through writing
- [Meet the Staff](https://teensinprint.com/meet-the-staff): Staff profiles and writing mentors at Teens in Print
